mapper.select: SELECT id, couple_id, week_start, day_num, checked, user_id, checkin_date, create_time, update_time FROM love_week_checkin WHERE couple_id = #{coupleId} AND week_start = #{weekStart} ORDER BY day_num
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO love_week_checkin (couple_id, week_start, day_num, checked, user_id, checkin_date) VALUES (#{coupleId}, #{weekStart}, #{dayNum}, #{checked}, #{userId}, #{checkinDate})

INSERT INTO love_week_checkin (couple_id, week_start, day_num, checked, user_id, checkin_date) VALUES (#{coupleId}, #{weekStart}, #{dayNum}, #{checked}, #{userId}, #{checkinDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checked = VALUES(checked), user_id = VALUES(user_id), checkin_date = VALUES(checkin_date)
